title: Popup menu ignores window sizes bigger than viewport size
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.7.2.stable.arch_linux [ed1daf0bf], v4.8.dev6.official [8898c2b3d]

### System information

Godot v4.7.2.stable (ed1daf0bf) - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Mon, 14 Sep 2026 22:41:30 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (nvidia; 615.71.09) - AMD Ryzen 5 2600 Six-Core Processor (12 threads) - 31.28 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When you have set window size overrides in project settings, the popup menu's height still uses the viewport's height. This also happens without setting the overrides and simply running the game in fullscreen.

The outcome is that the popup menu extends outside the screen, where you can't click.

This is a problem for pixel art games (and I suppose any game actually), because you have your viewport size set to small values, but use the override (or enter fullscreen) so the actual window is of usable size.

Window size override:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/19fc5799-ba7e-49d6-a44f-10cff359f965

Fullscreen:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3086c613-feba-4aa3-8464-ea60786c52ed

This might be somewhat related to #123615 and there could possibly be more things that don't take into account the window size overrides, which they should.

P.S. Something can be said about the size of the enum and consequently the dropdown, but I forgot what, and the point is that it should show all elements regardless. :D

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open MRP
2. Run the game and see that all of the dropdown elements can be viewed.
3. Close the game and override window size to 1280x720
4. Run the game again and notice that you can't see some of the bottom elements.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[popupmenu_test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32563551/popupmenu_test.zip)
